title: Dedupe and Membership with Set
prompt: Write `dedupeTags(tags)` that returns the unique tags of an array, preserving first-seen order, case-insensitively ("CSS" and "css" are the same tag; keep the first spelling seen). Also write `hasAll(tags, needed)` returning `true` only if every string in `needed` appears in `tags`.

tests.name: dedupes case-insensitively keeping first spelling
tests.hint: Track seen keys in a Set lowercased; push the original when not yet seen.

tests.name: hasAll checks every needed tag
tests.hint: Build a Set from tags once, then every() over needed with has().

tests.name: hasAll is efficient (uses Set, not nested loops)
tests.code: if (/\.includes\(.*\.includes/.test(code)) throw new Error("Nested includes is O(n²) — build a Set instead.");
tests.hint: const tagSet = new Set(tags); then needed.every((t) => tagSet.has(t)).
